fusions.name: Full Lamps
fusions.desc: Turns both carriage lamps on everything in a cone 4 tiles long. The glare deals 26 damage that ignores resistance and leaves each enemy [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bearing Down
fusions.desc: Fixes on a target up to 7 tiles away and rushes you to it. The blow deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lookout's Perch
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Watched Approach
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
